why: A 2024 paper (published in The Ramanujan Journal, 2025) by Benfield, Lippard, and Roy, 'End behavior of Ramanujan's taxicab numbers,' develops a general framework proving nonexistence of certain generalized taxicab numbers Taxicab(k,j,n) as j grows for fixed k, but search summaries did not confirm whether it specifically resolves the k=5, j=2 case (i.e., whether any number is a sum of two positive fifth powers in n>1 ways); other sources still describe this exact case as unresolved.
